name: Benchmark for Mental Health Systems
description: An evaluation dataset and metrics suite to assess diagnostic, triage, and therapeutic performance of automated mental health systems.
evaluation_method: composite of diagnostic accuracy, triage correctness, and human evaluation (clinical appropriateness)
reputation: Recognized in policy and research circles as a useful evaluation suite for automated mental health systems but not a broadly adopted public benchmark.
notes: High-stakes clinical benchmark requiring human/clinical validation; ethical, safety, and bias concerns; not suitable for deployment without oversight; likely includes mixed-format assessments (vignettes, decisions), non-LLM focused.
